title: hieracium scaberulum
intro: Hieracium scaberulum, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium scaberulum include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium scaberulum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
